content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I need some help. I have installed the latest [product_name] version [version_no], but I want to install the [product_name] web editor and the [product_name] access tool. I tried downloading them from the support page, but it seems the software has certain limitations. If you can help me with this, I would appreciate it. Best regards.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note that English is the official language here, so kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you. Downloading the software is subject to export restrictions, and you need to register additionally. After registration, you will receive an email from [company_name] confirming your download, which may take several days. Refer to this FAQ: Why do you need to log in and register to download export-restricted software and what information is required?
Understood, thank you for the information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges when trying to download [product_name] web editor and access tool, as export restrictions require additional registration and a waiting period. The process lacks clarity, resulting in user confusion about software availability and limitations. These restrictions and the unclear workflow affect usability and user trust.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect these tools to be easily and instantly downloadable from the support website, without hidden restrictions or lengthy registration processes.
